title: dnaa-9 — clean once-per-generation firing (dwell + SeqA), n=4/K=30
caption: Operating config: hydrolysis 0.025 + threshold 8 + async + dwell 30 s + SeqA eclipse 40 min (RIDA/DDAH/DARS off), seed 1. oriC is strictly 1<->2 (one initiation round per cycle), cell mass sawtooths regularly, oriC-low boxes fill to 8 (single origin) then reset each cycle, and the occupancy fires->resets once per generation. Seeds 1/2 are clean 1<->2; seed 0 retains ~13% oriC=3.
interpretation: Rashmi's requested re-tune for once-per-generation firing: the dwell (sustained-saturation requirement) combined with the SeqA eclipse (full-cycle re-initiation block) gives clean once-per-cell-cycle initiation with the DnaA-ATP fraction and pool in band. The residual oriC=3 on the fast-tau seed is the biologically-expected overlapping round (tau < C+D ~60 min).
